verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's `init` command writes SKILL.md skill files into both the Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) skill directories. A keyless dry-run probe confirmed both targets, and the files can be committed to share with a team. That covers the installation half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows how these skills auto-trigger from task context or how their descriptions are written to make the agent pick the right one. Missing for 10: documentation of auto-activation behavior, evidence of engineered trigger descriptions (skill frontmatter/description content), and hands-on corroboration that the skill activates at the right moment.
